column1: # comment: "QUDT alignments for measurement reference frames and quantity values. Contextual: gmeow:ReferenceFrame aligns to qudt:Unit only when the frame's realm is gmeow:frameRealmMeasurement. math:Quantity aligns to qudt:QuantityValue as the value+unit bundle. QUDT uses OWL punning (not strict DL); GMEOW keeps the alignment in the mapping layer only, never importing QUDT into the OWL 2 DL core."

column7: an axis defines the kind of quantity being measured (length, time, temperature, etc.)
contextual — holds when the ReferenceFrame's frameRealm is gmeow:frameRealmMeasurement
contextual — links a quantity value to its unit-of-measure frame
QUDT's standard uncertainty is the estimated standard deviation of the mean; GMEOW's quantityUncertainty is the same concept, in the same unit as the quantity value.

math:Dimension is an element of the ℚ-vector space over the SI base dimensions; qudt:QuantityKindDimensionVector is QUDT's dimension-vector concept — data, not a reasoned gate (GMEOW's differentiator). closeMatch, full IRI by reference.
math:Quantity aligns to qudt:Quantity, QUDT's dimensioned quantity. closeMatch (QUDT is a units spine to align to, not to subsume — Principle 17). Full IRI by reference.

QUDT QuantityValue is the close value-and-unit carrier; math:Quantity additionally requires an explicit dimension, while observation provenance, determinacy, and uncertainty remain qualifiers supplied by their owning slices.
math:amountOfSubstanceDimension (N) aligns to the QUDT quantity kind AmountOfSubstance. closeMatch. Full IRI by reference.
math:electricCurrentDimension (I) aligns to the QUDT quantity kind ElectricCurrent. closeMatch. Full IRI by reference.
math:lengthDimension (L) aligns to the QUDT quantity kind Length. closeMatch: a base dimension and the base quantity kind are close counterparts. Full IRI by reference.
math:luminousIntensityDimension (J) aligns to the QUDT quantity kind LuminousIntensity. closeMatch. Full IRI by reference.
math:massDimension (M) aligns to the QUDT quantity kind Mass. closeMatch. Full IRI by reference.

Both properties carry the concrete numeric magnitude of their quantity object; closeMatch remains validation-only because the surrounding GMEOW quantity contract also requires dimension and keeps observation qualifiers in their owning slices.
math:temperatureDimension (Θ) aligns to the QUDT quantity kind ThermodynamicTemperature. closeMatch. Full IRI by reference.
math:timeDimension (T) aligns to the QUDT quantity kind Time. closeMatch. Full IRI by reference.
